correctness.rationale: The exact local mass and weighted inverse matrices are assembled independently. Left-inverse identities give a rank-at-most-one positive-semidefinite update of the true inverse, hence two unit eigenvalues. Direct trace gives the third eigenvalue, whose square-defect factorization proves unique optimal weights. Reciprocal contrast and asymptotic case analysis give the complete exponent threshold, with exact critical supremum. Independent exact-rational checker passed 8,618 assertions; the continuous theorem follows from algebra, not sampling.

value.rationale: The smallest conforming mesh with a shared interface admits a complete exact spectrum for an adjustable practical weight family. The result answers a motivated robustness question with a necessary-and-sufficient power-law threshold and sharp boundary constant; it distinguishes enough local mass weighting from insufficient weighting without claiming broader mesh convergence.
